# Present indicative conjugation data

`present-data.js` adapts Italian data from [Ian Hamlin’s verb-data](https://github.com/ian-hamlin/verb-data/tree/master/json/italian), originally from [Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/). Each verb includes its original Wiktionary source URL.

The adapted conjugation data is available under [Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/), as specified by the source repository. Credit the original contributors, link this license, indicate changes, and distribute adaptations of this data under the same license. No endorsement is implied.

Changes made for Parola on 18 November 2026:
- Retained only present indicative forms of the 126 verb senses in the app’s frequency list.
- Kept one common modern form per person; omitted alternate, archaic and regional forms.
- Chose the source’s modern promuoviamo and promuovete variants.
- Decoded HTML entities; represented unavailable forms as null.
- Limited accadere and avvenire (“to happen”) to their common third-person forms; bisognare to its common impersonal third-person singular.
- Added short usage notes for these verbs and piacere.

The source frequency ranks and translations in words.js are credited separately to Atlas Runa. This notice covers the conjugation dataset.
